753:t_073:17.en:
$$ジャミル$$
「Our individual power is tiny, but joined together, it should become a mighty force!」

753:t_073:18.en:
$$ラクス$$
「We entrust that power to you, along with everyone's hopes.」

753:t_073:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The joint $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$-$$バジュラ$$ forces, the returning Galactic Raid Fleet and troops from many star systems are arriving in the $$地球圏$$!」

753:t_073:23.en:
$$マリーダ$$
(Master... You and the $$ガランシェール$$ team are fighting too.)

753:t_073:24.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「...So they will throw their lives away before the great collapse... Very well.」

753:t_014:1.en:
$$サルディアス$$
「Thank you for waiting, everyone. Humble remnants of $$サイデリアル$$ that we are... we have come to lend you our aid.」

753:t_014:2.en:
$$ダバラーン$$
「Leave the enemies around you to us!」

753:t_014:3.en:
$$尸刻$$
「You must defeat the source of the distortion!」

753:t_014:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$サルディアス$$! $$ダバラーン$$ and $$尸刻$$, too!」

753:t_014:5.en:
$$カティ$$
「This is Brigadier General $$カティ・マネキン$$ of the $$新地球連邦軍$$.」

753:t_014:7.en:
$$カティ$$
「We will commit all our forces to supporting $c! So don't give up hope!」

753:t_014:8.en:
$$イザーク$$
「Leave Earth's defense to us!」

753:t_014:9.en:
$$ディアッカ$$
「We're counting on you at the front!」

753:t_014:10.en:
$$アスラン$$
「$$イザーク$$! $$ディアッカ$$, too!」

753:t_014:11.en:
$$イズモ$$
「The $$アルテア$$ army will join you! We'll fight to the very last moment!」

753:t_014:13.en:
$$カグラ$$
「Old man $$イズモ$$ came here too?!」

753:t_014:14.en:
$$アマタ$$
「No, $$カグラ$$. He's our dad.」

753:t_014:16.en:
$$ヘンケン$$
「No one over here has given up either!」

753:t_014:17.en:
$$ジャミル$$
「Our individual power is tiny, but joined together, it should become a mighty force!」

753:t_014:18.en:
$$ラクス$$
「We entrust that power to you, along with everyone's hopes.」

753:t_014:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The joint $$ＥＬＳ#keyword$$-$$バジュラ$$ forces, the returning Galactic Raid Fleet and troops from many star systems are arriving in the $$地球圏$$!」

753:t_014:23.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「...So they will throw their lives away before the great collapse... Very well.」

753:t_015:0.en:
$$クルツ$$
「This is bad! Those monsters are heading for the reinforcements!」

753:t_015:1.en:
$$マオ$$
「They're the $$御使い$$s' forces! Regular troops who haven't achieved $$真化融合$$ won't stand a chance!」

753:t_015:2.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「They're sacrificing themselves to save us...」

753:t_015:3.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「The barrier protecting Earth vanished, and they gave in to desperation...」

753:t_015:4.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「...What a tragedy... Your continued futile resistance only creates needless suffering.」

753:t_015:5.en:
$$聖アドヴェント$$
「In just a few more minutes, everything will vanish... They could meet their end in peace. It is too sad.」

753:t_015:7.en:
$$オズマ$$
「They're fighting with pride! Every living being has a duty to do everything it can to survive!」

753:t_015:8.en:
$n
「No one... has given up! We haven't, and neither has anyone else!」

753:t_015:9.en:
$$トライア$$
「And that doesn't just mean the people on the battlefield!」

753:t_015:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「$$アドヴェント#pilot$$! It's time we showed you humanity's true strength!」

753:t_016:1.en:
$$トライア$$
「Yes... It's the light of the hearts of everyone on Earth.」

753:t_016:2.en:
$$トライア$$
「$$スヴェル$$ hadn't run out of time... Earth's people chose to deactivate it themselves to save their last strength.」

753:t_016:3.en:
$$トライア$$
「They did it to entrust their hopes and the power of their lives to $c!」

753:t_017:8.en:
$$刹那$$
($$マリナ・イスマイール$$, $$沙慈$$...)

753:t_017:12.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Of course! It's the power of every life on Earth!」

753:t_018:1.en:
$$シェリル$$
「Let's sing with all our strength too!」

753:t_019:0.en:
$$大杉$$
「We can't let them outdo us!」

753:t_019:1.en:
$$大山$$
「Let's have them carry our hopes too!」

753:t_020:1.en:
$$ミコット$$
「Yeah! I'm sure $$バナージ$$ and the others will turn our wishes into strength too!」

753:t_021:0.en:
$$チェーン$$
「The $$サイコ・フレーム$$... $$ＧＮ粒子$$, $$フォールドクォーツ$$ and $$Ｚクリスタル$$ are gathering people's wills.」

753:t_021:1.en:
$$アストナージ$$
「Our mechanics' wills are fused into $c's machines too!」

753:t_022:0.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Hang in there, everyone!! We're here with you!」

753:t_023:0.en:
$$シャア$$
「I can feel it... These aren't just the hopes of the living.」

753:t_023:1.en:
$$アムロ$$
「The souls of people we knew have come here too.」

753:t_023:2.en:
$$コンロイ$$
「Understood, Lieutenant Colonel $$ダグザ$$! I'll show them $$エコーズ$$'s pride and grit!」

753:t_023:3.en:
$$シモン$$
「Thanks, $$キタン$$! I'll add your power to mine and slam it into him!」

753:t_023:4.en:
$$刹那$$
「$$ロックオン$$...! I will change... and I'll make things change!」

753:t_023:5.en:
$$宗介$$
「Understood, Major $$カリーニン$$! I... will live!」

753:t_023:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「...I'm sorry, everyone... You're lending your strength even to someone like me...」

753:t_023:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「I'll carry the souls of everyone in the $$黒の騎士団$$!」

753:t_024:0.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I know, $$レナード$$... You can't accept his existence either.」

753:t_024:1.en:
$$かなめ$$
($$ソフィア$$... Even without whispers from the future, we'll win the future we want with our own strength!)

753:t_025:0.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「You can count on me, $$グラハム・エーカー$$!」
